tools.name: get_current_insights
tools.description: Muffed's published editorial reads on what is real in the NFL right now — each one a dated, sourced claim with its supporting figures, from the /trends board.

tools.name: query_stat_leaders
tools.description: Top entities on one verified metric for one season, pre-sorted, each with the source's own rank and the population it was ranked against. Call list_metrics for the metric keys this accepts.

tools.name: get_player_metrics
tools.description: Every verified figure Muffed holds for one player or team, with the source's rank where one exists. Names are resolved before lookup; an unrecognised name returns the closest matches rather than a guess.

tools.name: compare_entities
tools.description: Two players or two teams shown side by side on the verified metrics both have, with each side's source rank. States both figures and stops: it names no winner, no margin and no recommendation.

tools.name: get_metric_definition
tools.description: What a verified metric measures, which seasons it actually covers, how it is ranked, its licence and its attribution. Season coverage is often narrower than a decade — rushing yards over expectation, for instance, exists from 2018 onward.

tools.name: list_metrics
tools.description: The metric keys Muffed can answer on, with their labels and the seasons each one covers. Returns keys and coverage only, never figures.

tools.name: verify_claim
tools.description: Checks structured claims against Muffed's verified panel. Each claim comes back confirmed, wrong (with the actual value), or unverifiable (with the metric's real season coverage). Takes structured fields only, not sentences.

tools.name: get_backfield
tools.description: Muffed's published handcuff page for one team's backfield, plus the current depth chart and injury status from Sleeper. Answers who backs up a starter, and who replaces one who is out.

tools.name: sleeper_find_leagues
tools.description: Lists the NFL leagues a Sleeper username belongs to, so a league id can be picked for the other league tools. Muffed stores nothing about who called it.

tools.name: sleeper_get_league
tools.description: One league's name, season, size, current week, detected scoring format, and the manager-to-roster map. Everything downstream reads better once this has been called.

tools.name: sleeper_matchup_preview
tools.description: Both sides of a league matchup, with the verified figures Muffed holds for the players involved and each team's record. Muffed does not project outcomes, name a winner, or recommend a lineup.

tools.name: sleeper_roster_stories
tools.description: One team's roster mapped to the verified figures and published Muffed surfaces for each player. Players Muffed does not cover are listed as uncovered rather than omitted.

tools.name: sleeper_standings_story
tools.description: League standings derived from Sleeper's roster settings — records, points for, and points against where available. Sleeper publishes no standings endpoint, so these are computed from the roster rows.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "run_stat_query" is 1321 chars, far longer than this server's median (195). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Call this for any question about NFL statistics, leaders, rankings, splits, career or team spans, or how a player or team compares to others — including when yo…

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_player_metrics" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "compare_entities" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Two players or two teams shown side by side on the verified metrics both have, with each side's source rank. States both figures and stops: it names no winner, no margin and no recommendation." → after: "Two players or two teams shown side by side, on the metrics that matter for their position by default — name metrics explicitly, or pass all:true, for the full set. Each side carries its source rank. States both figures and stops: it names no winner, no margin and no recommendation."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
